newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco confirms tendering for 50,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco confirms tendering for 50,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Morocco confirmed it is tendering on Monday for 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat.
"We want it to be delivered in the first 10 days of January in the ports of Agadir, Tangier and Nador," an official at the state-owned Office National des Cereales et des Legumineuses (ONICL) said.
Agadir is in southern Morocco and the other two ports are in the north.
European traders reported the tender plan on December 11.
